svg.title: An Overseas Recovery Through Contact and Paperwork
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-overseas-recovery-balance; chapter number: 6; title: An Overseas Recovery Through Contact and Paperwork; subtitle: Danielle reports $97,000 reduced to $87,000 before negotiating a 20% fee.; caption: Danielle, appearing on Money Making Juggernaut, describes an overseas recovery using WhatsApp, Google Translate, and translated notarizations.; assumptions note: Danielle reports a balance reduction, not a lead-conversion funnel. The $87,000 repeated through contact, documentation, and agreement is the same after-tax reference balance, not a separately measured balance at each milestone.; note: Danielle's 20% is a negotiated fee, not a conversion rate. The $87,000 is not the owner's net receipt after that fee. Contact and documentation milestones do not establish an exact chronology for every exchange.; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Initial reported funds; value: 97000; display: $97,000; conversion: Not a lead-conversion measure; detail: Danielle identifies this amount before the reduction for back taxes.; label: After back taxes; value: 87000; display: $87,000; conversion: Back-tax adjustment; detail: Danielle reports that back taxes reduced the funds to this amount before the fee discussion.; label: Overseas communication; value: 87000; display: $87,000 reference balance; conversion: No separate balance change reported; detail: Danielle uses WhatsApp and Google Translate to communicate with the overseas owner. The amount remains a reference to the reported after-tax funds.; label: Translated notarizations; value: 87000; display: $87,000 reference balance; conversion: No separate balance change reported; detail: Translated notarizations support Danielle's recovery work. No separate documentation-stage balance is reported.; label: Negotiated recovery agreement; value: 87000; display: $87,000 before the recovery fee; conversion: 20% negotiated fee, not conversion; detail: Danielle reports negotiating a 20% fee and completing the overseas recovery. This amount is not the operator's fee or the owner's net distribution.

circle.title: label: Initial reported funds; value: 97000; display: $97,000; conversion: Not a lead-conversion measure; detail: Danielle identifies this amount before the reduction for back taxes.
label: After back taxes; value: 87000; display: $87,000; conversion: Back-tax adjustment; detail: Danielle reports that back taxes reduced the funds to this amount before the fee discussion.

label: Overseas communication; value: 87000; display: $87,000 reference balance; conversion: No separate balance change reported; detail: Danielle uses WhatsApp and Google Translate to communicate with the overseas owner. The amount remains a reference to the reported after-tax funds.

label: Translated notarizations; value: 87000; display: $87,000 reference balance; conversion: No separate balance change reported; detail: Translated notarizations support Danielle's recovery work. No separate documentation-stage balance is reported.

label: Negotiated recovery agreement; value: 87000; display: $87,000 before the recovery fee; conversion: 20% negotiated fee, not conversion; detail: Danielle reports negotiating a 20% fee and completing the overseas recovery. This amount is not the operator's fee or the owner's net distribution.

text.title: Assumptions: Danielle reports a balance reduction, not a lead-conversion funnel. The $87,000 repeated through contact, documentation, and agreement is the same after-tax reference balance, not a separately measured balance at each milestone.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Danielle reports a balance reduction, not a lead-conversion funnel. The $87,000 repeated through contact, documentation,
